Who benefits, or might be harmed? She writes the weekly AI Prognosis newsletter . Follow her on Threads , Mastodon , and Bluesky . You can reach Brittany on Signal at btrang.01. Get email alerts for Brittany Trang Signed up for email alerts Remove email alerts Subscribe or log in to STAT+ to unlock email alerts SAN MATEO, Calif. — Peyton Greenside, CEO of BigHat Biosciences, has hot takes. Her company designs antibody therapies using machine-learning, but she doesn’t like demos in which people open their computers and show off how fast they can design a drug. “If you want me to design you a protein right now in six hours, I’m happy to do it,” she said. Advertisement In fact, she can do it in 20 minutes. But if you’re actually in the business of making drugs, you are still going to have to do all the downstream tests, which take time and lots of money, Greenside said. “That’s where the hard work is, is making the actual drug.” To read the rest of this story subscribe to STAT+.
